title: Thai Penne Pasta Delight
description: A flavorful and nutritious Thai-inspired pasta dish made with mild and nourishing ingredients. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook the penne pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the nourishing oil over medium heat.
Add the mild Arabic spice blend and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the Saudi Arabian dates and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the cooked penne pasta to the skillet and toss with the date and spice mixture.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and freshly squeezed lime juice.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
